remarks.cs: TSP – Tango Specific Principles (Specifické principy Tanga): Tangová chůze a akce Dovnitř – Ven jsou popsány v technické příručce WDSF.
remarks.en: TSP – Tango Specific Principles: the Tango Walk and the In – Out action are described in the WDSF technique book.

remarks.cs: Figury a akce, které mohou být použity v postaveních Right Side Same Position nebo Right Diagonal Same Position (váha je na stejných nohách, M a F tančí stejné kroky – kroky M nebo F): Travelling Volta to R / to L, Circular Volta to R / to L, Spot Volta to L / to R, Continuous Spot Volta to R / to L, Corta Jaca, Travelling Botafogos Forward, Stationary Samba Walks, Promenade Samba Walks, Carioca Runs, Side Samba Chasse, Samba Whisk to R and L, Dropped Volta, Rhythm Bounce.
remarks.en: Figures and actions that may be used in Right Side Same Position or Right Diagonal Same Position (weight on the same foot, Man and Lady dance the same steps – Man's or Lady's): Travelling Volta to R / to L, Circular Volta to R / to L, Spot Volta to L / to R, Continuous Spot Volta to R / to L, Corta Jaca, Travelling Botafogos Forward, Stationary Samba Walks, Promenade Samba Walks, Carioca Runs, Side Samba Chasse, Samba Whisk to R and L, Dropped Volta, Rhythm Bounce.

remarks.cs: Následující figury mohou být použity v postaveních Right nebo Left Side Same Position, doba trvání je maximálně 6 taktů (mimo změny nohou): Ronde Chasse, Hip Twist Chasse, Slip Close Chasse, Time Step Chasse, Whisk Chasse, Running Chasse fwd / bwd, Cha Cha Lock fwd / bwd, Three Cha Chas fwd / bwd, 2 Walks and a fwd Lockstep (vše RF i LF). Dále kroky M nebo F v figurách: Basic in Place, Time Step, There and Back, Close Basic, Open Basic, Spot Turn to R and L, Cuban Breaks to R and L, Split Cuban Breaks to R and L, Walks and Whisks, Three Cha Cha Chas to R and L.
remarks.en: The following figures may be used in Right or Left Side Same Position for a maximum of 6 bars (excluding the foot changes): Ronde Chasse, Hip Twist Chasse, Slip Close Chasse, Time Step Chasse, Whisk Chasse, Running Chasse fwd / bwd, Cha Cha Lock fwd / bwd, Three Cha Chas fwd / bwd, 2 Walks and a fwd Lockstep (all RF and LF). Also the Man's or Lady's steps of: Basic in Place, Time Step, There and Back, Close Basic, Open Basic, Spot Turn to R and L, Cuban Breaks to R and L, Split Cuban Breaks to R and L, Walks and Whisks, Three Cha Cha Chas to R and L.

remarks.cs: Forward and backward Walks seskupení: po jakékoliv figuře nebo části figury, která končí v Open Opposition Position, se může použít série Fwd nebo Bwd Walks v délce 2 takty (6 kroků). Když M tančí Fwd Walks, F tančí Bwd Walks a naopak; chůze se může zahýbat do P nebo do L. M a F smí tančit sérii Fwd Walks v délce max. 2 taktů (6 kroků) v R Side nebo L Side Same Position (např. po Hand to Hand).
remarks.en: Forward and backward Walks amalgamations: after any figure or part of a figure ending in Open Opposition Position a series of Fwd or Bwd Walks of 2 bars (6 steps) may be used. When the Man dances Fwd Walks the Lady dances Bwd Walks and vice versa; the walks may curve to R or L. Man and Lady may dance a series of Fwd Walks of max. 2 bars (6 steps) in R Side or L Side Same Position (e.g. after Hand to Hand).

remarks.cs: DTV-NF: DTV Neue Figuren (příručka a video vydané DTV pro doplnění příruček WDSF). JSP – Jive Specific Principles (Specifické principy Jive).
remarks.en: DTV-NF: DTV Neue Figuren (book and video published by the German DTV supplementing the WDSF books). JSP – Jive Specific Principles.
